records.trigger: Bug: root npm test (full suite, run by done_required) fails when packages/utils/dist is absent because full-suite sub-tests spawn bin/lattice.js and bootstrap-runner.js refuses to start without packages/utils/dist; nothing auto-builds utils.
records.observedFailure: node packages/main/tests/red/red-fb7b-pretest-builds-utils.mjs exits 1 with: AssertionError: RED: root package.json has no "pretest" script — nothing auto-builds packages/utils before npm test, so a worktree without packages/utils/dist runs the full suite with utils absent and bin/lattice.js sub-tests die at bootstrap-runner.
records.note: RED asserts a root pretest builds packages/main then packages/utils, plus the invariant links (bootstrap-runner requires utils/dist; test invokes full-suite-runner) and a behavioral npm run pretest that produces packages/utils/dist. Baseline fails on the missing pretest; the fix makes it green.
